added.title: Senior Vice President of Technology
added.description:
Company Description
Reale Mutua Assicurazioni Chieri is part of an established insurance group committed to providing reliable and customer-focused insurance solutions. The organization is known for combining strong financial stability with innovation in products and services. Team members work in a collaborative environment that values integrity, professional excellence, and continuous improvement. The company invests in technology and talent to enhance service quality and operational efficiency. Joining Reale Mutua Assicurazioni Chieri offers the opportunity to influence the digital evolution of a respected insurance brand.
Role Description
The Senior Vice President of Technology is a full-time, remote leadership role responsible for setting and executing the overall technology vision and strategy for Reale Mutua Assicurazioni Chieri. This role oversees the design, implementation, and optimization of core IT systems, infrastructure, and digital platforms that support insurance operations and customer experience. Day-to-day responsibilities include leading technology teams, prioritizing and managing complex projects, aligning IT initiatives with business objectives, and ensuring robust governance, security, and compliance. The SVP of Technology collaborates closely with executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive innovation, evaluate emerging technologies, and support strategic decision-making. This position also focuses on building a high-performing culture, mentoring leaders, managing vendor relationships, and optimizing budgets and resources to deliver measurable business outcomes.
Qualifications

Strong Analytical Skills to interpret complex data, assess technology performance, and support evidence-based decision-making.
Deep expertise in Information Technology, including enterprise systems, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud-based solutions.
Proven experience in IT Strategy and Strategic Planning, with the ability to align technology roadmaps to long-term business goals.
Demonstrated Project Management capabilities leading multi-disciplinary teams and large-scale technology initiatives.
Extensive senior leadership experience in technology roles, preferably within financial services or insurance.
Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, with strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience managing technology budgets, vendor contracts, and service-level agreements.
Advanced degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Familiarity with regulatory requirements and industry standards relevant to insurance and financial services.
Track record of driving digital transformation and change management in complex organizations.

added.title: Vice President, Technology Operations
added.description:
About the Opportunity

The company is seeking a seasoned technology operations leader with direct experience in data, data operations, hosting infrastructure (both public and private cloud), development operations, and cybersecurity. This individual will join a top-notch team in an exciting, innovative, and dynamic environment.

Your Area of Focus

Lead the adoption and usage of advanced AI technologies across the operations organization to improve overall internal efficiency, accelerating product and business outcomes.
Stay informed on leading technology operational trends and AI advancements, identifying creative solutions to incorporate for efficiency and greater throughput.
Provide leadership, vision, and strategy to drive automation, stability, and availability of the technology infrastructure, leveraging cloud and on-premise technologies to support business agility and maximize efficiencies.
Drive innovation across security, data privacy, data and development operations, and infrastructure.
Define the technology operations strategy and roadmap to support current and future business needs for scalability, growth capacity, and quality of service (performance, reliability, and business continuity).
Define requirements for new technology implementations and communicate them clearly to key business stakeholders.
Partner with senior leaders across the business to realize measurable outcomes aligned with business expectations.
Drive the execution of security, data, infrastructure, and technology operations initiatives and projects to achieve expected scalability, performance, and availability targets.
Assess and communicate risks associated with technology-related investments and purchases.
Support business growth initiatives by aligning the technology operations vision with the business strategy.
Develop business case justifications and cost/benefit analyses for technology operations spending and initiatives.
Develop and implement the people, process, and technologies necessary for meeting current and future customer demands.
Define, maintain, and present metrics to the executive and leadership team on a regular basis, including overall security, data, and infrastructure health, risk areas, productivity stats, and overall health of technology operations.
Define, measure, and improve technology standards across the organization to establish a technology-enabled competitive edge.
Provide reliable due diligence and technical assessments of potential acquisitions.

Your Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, information systems, or engineering.
15 years of experience managing technology operations in the fields of development operations, data, infrastructure, and cybersecurity.
Extensive knowledge and direct experience with AI tools and methodologies, including their application to improve operational efficiency.
Strong technical background in an environment with a heterogeneous mix of on-premise, hosted, and cloud hardware and software.
Experience leading operational technologies for deployment, maintenance, and monitoring of large-scale SaaS platforms.
Experience with hosting operations and leading cloud migrations with AWS, Azure, and GCP.
Experience managing vendor relationships and negotiating contracts to bring the best solutions while optimizing expense costs.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate technical details and strategy to non-technical leadership.
Demonstrated success leading modernization and transformation initiatives across data and infrastructure environments.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity methodologies and practices to stay ahead of growing security threats.
Demonstrated success in leading large, diverse global teams.
Effective people leader who attracts and retains strong talent.
Expert knowledge of technology environments, including networks, operating systems, databases, application and web servers.
Technical experience with systems networking, databases, infrastructure, and user support.
Experience defining standardized operating procedures and services across various operational disciplines.
Experience in strategic technology planning, execution, and policy development.
Experience with business processes, management, and budgeting.
Strong understanding of project management principles.
Proven experience in planning, organization, and development.
Demonstrated ability to apply technology solutions to business problems.
Experience with acquisition due diligence and integrations.

Compensation and Benefits

The company is dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with competitive and fair compensation. For this position, the compensation range reflects a national average pay band. Specific compensation is determined by experience, qualifications, role requirements, and geographic zone. The geo-zone system ensures pay is competitive for the location, recognizing varying costs of labor.

The four geo zones are:
Zone 1: National Average
Zone 2: Moderately Higher Cost Regions
Zone 3: High-Cost Regions
Zone 4: Lower-Cost Regions

Beyond base compensation, eligible employees have the opportunity for variable pay and a robust benefits package. In compliance with California pay transparency laws, the specific compensation range applicable to your Geo Zone will be shared during the initial talent screen.

Zone 1 (National Average) $282,000—$322,000 USD

The organization offers a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare benefits, and additional perks. Resources are available to support employee well-being, including fitness programs and mental health resources.

About the Organization

The organization is an all-in-one platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. It is designed to replace fragmented tools built for corporate systems, connecting EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solutions, and marketing. This allows providers to spend less time on administration and more time with patients. Many private practices trust the organization to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout, helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose.

Our Values

Start with the Customer:
Understanding customers and their patients, and viewing the world through their lens.
Keep It Simple:
Aiming to simplify healthcare for everyone.
Stay Entrepreneurial:
Rejecting the status quo and solving problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action.
Better Together:
Being diverse, humble, and collaborative, putting the team first and winning together.
Celebrate Success:
Taking time to have fun and celebrate success.

The hiring company is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.
